It's a game that allows players to lose themselves in the roleplay, the heists, and the crime sprees. But for me, an occasional dipper into its major updates, the car folk have always been the engine driving its appeal. Read more

titulo: I've never known a moment like this in video games
resumo: It was hard not to spend the first hour or so of Grand Theft Auto 6 's launch day in a kind of stun-lock. As far as video games editorial goes - which is not that far, in fairness; prepare for an over-flattering analogy - the effect was roughly the equivalent of Tom Hanks' experience, as his John H. Miller first set foot on Omaha beach. Tweets and reels whistled overhead, news leads stung the ears, exploding search terms blew apart some poor guides team ally on one side, while new discoveries in the early game - made by the millions and millions of launch-day players all picking it apart at once - appeared by surprise like some flanking ambush on the other. Read more

titulo: Feature: Don't Have Your Wii Set Up? Here Are 20 Wii Games You Can Play On Switch

Even if it's collecting dust in the cupboard after launching 20 years ago, there's over 100 million of the things out in the wild, so the chances are that you or your family have access to one somewhere. However, on the off-chance you don't have a Wii to hand — or you sold it years ago to save three DVDs' worth of space — don't fret.
